metadata.title: INSTRUCTION SUR L'ESSAI DES MATIÈRES D'ARGENT PAR LA VOIE HUMIDE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (such as Didot or Bodoni), which was the standard for official French printing in the early 19th century.
